title: NCCIA Releases Roll Number Slips for Physical and Endurance Tests
excerpt: Candidates can now access their roll number slips for upcoming physical and endurance tests issued by the NCCIA.
body_html:
The National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency (NCCIA) has officially released the roll number slips for candidates scheduled to appear in upcoming physical and endurance tests.

Applicants who applied for the relevant positions can now obtain their slips to participate in these mandatory evaluation stages.
